name: Tone Source
rules: Plays what the MAX9814 mic breakout would hear: a 300 Hz tone on a 1.25 V offset.
Off, talk (0.2 V) or horn (1 V): choose it in the parts panel while the power's on.
Powered from VDD (2.7–5.5 V), like the real breakout.
flavor: The real one hears the train. This one pretends, on cue.
